sloka: स शरौघसमायस्तो नीलः कपिचमूपतिः ।करेणैकेन शेलाग्रं रक्षोधिपतये ऽसृजत् ।। ६.५९.७२ ।।।।
transliteration: sa śaraughasamāyasto nīlaḥ kapicamūpatiḥ ।kareṇaikena śelāgraṁ rakṣodhipataye 'sṛjat ।। 6.59.72 ।।।।

translations.english: The ten headed indomitable Lord of Rakshasas with his arrows that resembled serpents, dreadful, capable of piercing into vital parts began to strike at Neela, the leader of monkeys.
